nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) public balances; token ledger
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance; spender approvals
IEP20 eventer; external contract used for the wevent() gate
uint256 public totalSupply = 1e12 * 1e18; total minted supply
string public name = 'Baby Dragon'
string public symbol = hex'42616279447261676F6Ef09f9089'
uint public decimals = 18
Attacker-controlled caller used for balance credit, debits, allowance lookup and the wevent gate argument
constructor(IEP20 _consparam) sets eventer and mints totalSupply to msg.sender
function balanceOf(address wallet) public view returns (uint256)
function dgst(address acct) public pure returns (bytes memory) - abi.encodePacked(acct)
function transfer(address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool); gated by eventer.wevent(ripemd160(dgst(msg.sender))) != 1
function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public returns (bool); gated by eventer.wevent(ripemd160(dgst(from))) != 1 and allowance
function approve(address holder, uint256 value) public returns (bool)
External call eventer.wevent(ripemd160(dgst(msg.sender))) inside transfer; the invoked contract decides whether a transfer succeeds
External call eventer.wevent(ripemd160(dgst(from))) inside transferFrom; external contract controls transfer success

Unchecked arithmetic balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.7.6, no SafeMath)

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the whole initial totalSupply in the constructor and is emitted in Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, totalSupply)
totalSupply is read to credit balances[msg.sender] in the constructor
constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply
constructor assigns the external IEP20 contract to eventer
balanceOf reads balances[wallet] and returns it
transfer uses msg.sender for the wevent gate, balanceOf check, debit and Transfer event
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance[from][msg.sender] authorises the transfer
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][holder], keyed by the untrusted caller
transfer reads and mutates balances via balanceOf and direct writes
transferFrom reads and mutates balances of from and to
transferFrom enforces require(allowance[from][msg.sender] >= value) before moving tokens
approve sets allowance[msg.sender][holder] = value
transfer calls the eventer state variable to evaluate the wevent() gate
transferFrom calls the eventer state variable to evaluate the wevent() gate
transfer executes the external call eventer.wevent(...) as a required precondition
transferFrom executes the external call eventer.wevent(...) as a required precondition
The external gate result depends on ripemd160(dgst(msg.sender)); the external contract can veto or allow any caller, giving it implicit control over transfers
transfer performs unchecked balances[to] += value and balances[msg.sender] -= value
transferFrom performs unchecked balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value
transfer invokes balanceOf(msg.sender) for the sufficiency check
transferFrom invokes balanceOf(from) for the sufficiency check
transfer invokes dgst(msg.sender) to build the wevent argument
transferFrom invokes dgst(from) to build the wevent argument
The wevent() call hands control to an attacker-supplied IEP20 contract, which may re-enter transfer/transferFrom before state updates complete
The wevent() call hands control to an attacker-supplied IEP20 contract, which may re-enter transferFrom before balances and allowance are updated
eventer is the target contract of the external wevent() call in transfer
eventer is the target contract of the external wevent() call in transferFrom
parameter to receives the credited balances[to] in transfer
parameter value is added to balances[to] and subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without SafeMath
parameter from is debited in balances[from] inside transferFrom
parameter to is credited in balances[to] inside transferFrom
parameter value drives the unchecked balances updates in transferFrom
parameter holder indexes the allowance mapping written by approve
parameter value is stored into allowance[msg.sender][holder]
parameter wallet indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf
parameter acct is abi.encodePacked into the dgst return value
parameter _consparam is stored into the eventer state variable

Parameter value is the operand of the unchecked balances increments/decrements in transfer.

Parameter to is only used inside transferFrom to credit balances.
Parameter value is the operand of the unchecked balances updates in transferFrom.
